by abstention, D-K2-2) · **SIG-UI-050** (no-JS fallbacks kept) ·
findings closed: **QW-12**, **K1 NEW-20**, **K12b NEW-7**, **K2 NEW-6 /
D-K2-2**, **K6 NEW-1** ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.14-jurisdiction-display-names-interim` (chain tip —
merge after it) ·
**Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/217_P34.15__map-network-search-island-honesty.md`
(manifest row 217 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) ·
**Live stage:** **none** — code + copy + tests only; the public effect

`live_verification=false`.

## Why

The three interactive islands overstated in four ways:

1. **`/map/` said "devices"/"assets"**, listed every catalogued layer
   whether or not the build carried records for it (an empty legend entry
   implies data), and printed a raw `deviceCount` on value-suppressed
   bins — a number on a cell SIG barely looked at reads as confidence the
   record does not carry (QW-12). Its intro also claimed the map "renders
   as static content with no client JavaScript" directly above the JS
   island (K1 NEW-20). The per-record "⚠ Unresolved" gap affordances
   already pointed at the `/task/new/` surface P34.12 retired; what was
   missing was the honest replacement (K12b NEW-7).
2. **`/network/` published a centrality ranking** whose inline disclosure
   claimed the edge endpoints were "minted by deterministic identity
   resolution … exact for the exported graph … never an estimate" — while
   organisation entity resolution has not passed its gate (K2 NEW-6).
   The figure and the claim are both withdrawn (D-K2-2, SIG-IDENT-030 by
   abstention): the page now states the abstention — SIG has not merged
   organisations across sources; the review that would make a ranking
   honest has not passed — instead of showing a statistic dressed as a
   measurement.
3. **Every island silently ignored facets it does not apply.** A
   `?v=1&jurisdiction=US-OK` address parsed, round-tripped, and rendered
   the unfiltered view with no note — a link that looks scoped but is not
   (K6 NEW-1, interim for UXR-10).

## What this does

1. **The map counts records and lists only what has data.** The tabular
   equivalent says "records" throughout; `layerControlsWithData` /
   `layersWithData` filter the legend and the observed/derived explainer
   to layers carrying records in this build (a note says unlisted layers
   have no records); `binCountLabel` prints `suppressed` where a
   value-suppressed bin's count would stand — table, SVG cell and title
   alike, never a figure. `locatable + Σ indicators` still equals every
   record (SIG-UI-020).
2. **Contested locations lead to the dossier.** A per-jurisdiction
   contested count (`locationAbsence === "UNRESOLVED"` — the same absence
   the export emits for `point_status="conflicted"`) replaces the retired
   per-record gap affordances; it links `/dossier/<slug>/` only when a
   dossier with that slug exists (`jurisdictionSlug` mirrors the
   exporter's `_slugify`), so a count never links a 404. The fixture
   gains a conflicting-coordinates record so the count is exercised.
3. **The network abstains honestly.** `analytics.py` emits
   `statistics: []` (the `focus` block keeps its stated rule — the ego
   centre's pick mechanism, not a ranking); the fixture export mirror,
   the fixture module, `getNetworkCentrality`, the page section and the
   island's `centrality` prop are all gone. `CentralityStatistic` /
   `ErQuality` and their structural SIG-UI-023 disclosure contract stay
   in `network.ts` for the gate's return.
4. **Every island says when it ignores a facet.** `WorkspaceParse.present`
   reports which contract parameters were present; `APPLIED_PARAMS` names
   what each view applies (list: `release/q/kind/focus`; map: +
   `collection`; network: `release/focus`); `unappliedParams` +
   `facetNoticeText` render the batch-row WS-01 notice
   (`data-testid="facet-not-applied"`) on all three islands. A pytest
   sweep fails if any literal island link carries a parameter the target
   ignores, and if any `/task/` link or withdrawn claim returns.

## Boundaries

- No production mutation; nothing published (P34.17 owns republish #1).
- The `focus` block in `analytics/web/centrality.json` stays: it is the
  ego view's stated pick mechanism — a presentation device with a named
  rule, explicitly not a published ranking.
- `page` is announced as ignored on every island today (no island
  paginates) — the contract field round-trips unchanged.
- Export compat: the artifact schema is unchanged (`statistics` was
  already a list; it is now empty) — older readers see an empty list,
  not a missing key. `getNetworkCentrality()` is deliberately removed
  from the web seam rather than returning `[]` so the public surface
  cannot silently re-render a withdrawn statistic.
- Diff budget: 26 files, ≈ +740/−230 (well under the ≤1,500 ceiling).
